title: LLMConfig
description:
Configuration for Language Model (LLM) connection and generation parameters.

.. deprecated::
    LLMConfig is deprecated and should not be used as an input or return type in API calls.
    Use the schemas in letta.schemas.model (ModelSettings, OpenAIModelSettings, etc.) instead.
    For conversion, use the _to_model() method or Model._from_llm_config() method.

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: A human-friendly display name for the model.

model_endpoint_type.title: Model Endpoint Type
model_endpoint_type.description: The endpoint type for the model.

provider_name.title: Provider Name
provider_name.description: The provider name for the model.

provider_category.description: The provider category for the model.

context_window.title: Context Window
context_window.description: The context window size for the model.

put_inner_thoughts_in_kwargs.title: Put Inner Thoughts In Kwargs
put_inner_thoughts_in_kwargs.description: Puts 'inner_thoughts' as a kwarg in the function call if this is set to True. This helps with function calling performance and also the generation of inner thoughts.

handle.title: Handle
handle.description: The handle for this config, in the format provider/model-name.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: The temperature to use when generating text with the model. A higher temperature will result in more random text.

max_tokens.title: Max Tokens
max_tokens.description: The maximum number of tokens to generate. If not set, the model will use its default value.

enable_reasoner.title: Enable Reasoner
enable_reasoner.description: Whether or not the model should use extended thinking if it is a 'reasoning' style model

reasoning_effort.title: Reasoning Effort
reasoning_effort.description: The reasoning effort to use when generating text reasoning models

max_reasoning_tokens.title: Max Reasoning Tokens
max_reasoning_tokens.description: Configurable thinking budget for extended thinking. Used for enable_reasoner and also for Google Vertex models like Gemini 2.5 Flash. Minimum value is 1024 when used with enable_reasoner.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: The effort level for Anthropic models that support it (Opus 4.5, Opus 4.6). Controls token spending and thinking behavior. Not setting this gives similar performance to 'high'.

frequency_penalty.title: Frequency Penalty
frequency_penalty.description: Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim. From OpenAI: Number between -2.0 and 2.0.

compatibility_type.title: Compatibility Type
compatibility_type.description: The framework compatibility type for the model.

verbosity.title: Verbosity
verbosity.description: Soft control for how verbose model output should be, used for GPT-5 models.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: The cost tier for the model (cloud only).

parallel_tool_calls.title: Parallel Tool Calls
parallel_tool_calls.description: Deprecated: Use model_settings to configure parallel tool calls instead. If set to True, enables parallel tool calling. Defaults to False.

response_format.title: Response Format
response_format.description: The response format for the model's output. Supports text, json_object, and json_schema (structured outputs). Can be set via model_settings.

strict.title: Strict
strict.description: Enable strict mode for tool calling. When true, tool schemas include strict: true and additionalProperties: false, guaranteeing tool outputs match JSON schemas.

return_logprobs.title: Return Logprobs
return_logprobs.description: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens. Useful for RL training.

top_logprobs.title: Top Logprobs
top_logprobs.description: Number of most likely tokens to return at each position (0-20). Requires return_logprobs=True.

return_token_ids.title: Return Token Ids
return_token_ids.description: Whether to return token IDs for all LLM generations via SGLang native endpoint. Required for multi-turn RL training with loss masking. Only works with SGLang provider.

tool_call_parser.title: Tool Call Parser
tool_call_parser.description: SGLang tool call parser name (e.g. 'glm47', 'qwen25', 'hermes'). Used by the SGLang native adapter to parse tool calls from raw model output.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of the response format.

TextResponseFormat.title: TextResponseFormat
TextResponseFormat.description: Response format for plain text responses.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of the response format.

json_schema.title: Json Schema
json_schema.description: The JSON schema of the response.

JsonSchemaResponseFormat.title: JsonSchemaResponseFormat
JsonSchemaResponseFormat.description: Response format for JSON schema-based responses.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of the response format.

JsonObjectResponseFormat.title: JsonObjectResponseFormat
JsonObjectResponseFormat.description: Response format for JSON object responses.
